argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$h=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/health' -TimeoutSec 4
Write-Output ('HEALTH='+$h.state)
foreach($r in @($h.reasons)){Write-Output ('REASON='+([string]$r).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(180,([string]$r).Length)))}
Write-Output ('QUEUE_ACTIVE='+[string]$h.assignmentQueue.active)
Write-Output ('QUEUE_QUEUED='+[string]$h.assignmentQueue.queued)
$cut=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/projects/control-plane/cutover-r42/status' -TimeoutSec 4
Write-Output ('R42_HOLD='+[string]$cut.cutoverState.holdActive)
Write-Output ('BRIDGE_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
